claim: citation_resolver.py doi uses https://api.crossref.org/works as the canonical CrossRef endpoint for resolving DOIs
sub_question: Which API does citation_resolver.py doi use as the canonical CrossRef endpoint for resolving DOIs?
evidence: Module constant CROSSREF_API is set to the CrossRef works API base URL; resolve_doi_crossref builds the request as CROSSREF_API/{doi}.
notes: Verified by reading scripts/citation_resolver.py lines 58 and 182-184; auto and explicit crossref DOI resolution call resolve_doi_crossref which uses CROSSREF_API.
